default/30424.htm.text: Allana: Darkness pre... prevails in the wo... world! I, the sacred flame of prophecy, will drive out da... darkness! I, I... shall perform miracles of light... to pu... purify the world..!

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30424-01.html.text: Allana: How could I have possibly incited Perrin? I remember mentioning in conversation a girl with strange powers who grew up with me in the orphanage. Soon afterward, Perrin asked me about her. I told him everything I knew... We were in an orphanage near Gludio Castle ...

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30424-02.html.text: Allana : We grew up together in an orphanage near Gludio Castle that was operated by a Dwarven Father.

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30424-05.htm.text: Allana: (From the crystal necklace, all of a sudden, a voice comes out). This is Priest Manuel. I have something urgent to tell you. So, please come back into the temple.

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30424-02.htm.text: Allana: What was that monster? I'm afraid... I don't want to die... I don't want to abandon my brother and die! I don't want to trick people anymore! However, Perrin didn't give me the money he owes me yet. I wrote down all the work I've done until now in my diary. I will give this to you... Please…

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30424-04.htm.text: Allana: Sob... It is too late... I couldn't minister medicine at the proper time... My brother... is dead. He was so kind... and with such a pure heart. My poor brother... When he was tortured with sickness... Where was your god? Sob... I don't need money any more! Go! I want to be alone!

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30424-07.htm.text: Allana: How dare you! Do you doubt me? To the sacred flame of prophecy... Are you giving a command? How, how dare you!

links.text: False sacred flames are severely punished by the church.
I am sorry to have doubted, it is dangerous here, let's go.

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30424-08.htm.text: Allana: We must go... together? No! I don't want to go! I must take care of my little brother. Miracles and sacred flame of prophecy... they were all lies! Perrin made me do it... He brought fake patients and acted like we prayed for treatment... And acted like a miracle had happened. I knew it was…

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30424-09.htm.text: Allana: Pu... punished? Like a witch... Will I be burnt at the stake? I, I'm sorry... They are all lies!
